name: Доступ до короля
description:
Attacking in chess is not easy. The opponent's king is deep in the enemy camp, while our pieces have to cross the middle first. Still, sometimes attacking opportunities arise. Especially at times when the defenders are not paying attention, opportunities arise to attack the enemy king.

The goal of this lesson is to gain access to the enemy king. Sometimes (temporary) sacrifices must be made, at other times pieces must simply be maneuvered forward.

What do you have to do?
Try to gain access to the opponent's king. This may sometimes cost some material temporarily. Look for mate, but also be satisfied with winning material.

examples.text: In this example, we gain access to the king by sacrificing our knight. After the knight is captured, the white queen can invade. In the process, the black knight is lost. White thus wins back the material and the black king remains vulnerable.

examples.pgn: {[#]} 1. d5 {[%csl Gb2,Ge4][%cal Gb2h8,Ge4f6]} exd5 2. Nf6+ Qxf6 3. Bxf6 *
examples.text: In this example, we can open the lines to black king by moving our central pawn forward. Suddenly the white bishop joins the attack. On the second move a very strong check follows with the knight. If black captures the knight then it costs the queen and if black does not capture, white has a powerful discovered check. The white attack soon wins a huge amount of material.

texts: Sometimes sacrifices are needed to launch an attack.
